assessment.governing_intent: Make design applicability depend on direction and coupling evidence under the 2026-09-25 Founder coupling disposition. Existing approved architecture checks, plus scoped cross-module cycle detection, domain-import classification and persistence-ownership checks, must run mechanically before a fresh independent design review. A forbidden dependency or incompatible interface must fail mechanically. A conforming fixture must record the mechanical results and a separate attributable independent review. The withdrawn R1 allowed_edges table must not be enforced (SF-REQ-051, AC-03).
implementation_unknowns: Where bounded-context ownership and the permitted stable value/port contracts are machine-readably defined (the pinned Phase 9 shared contracts), so domain imports can be classified against them rather than against raw import presence.

How the existing tools/fitness/check_architecture.py structures its checks, and whether cycle detection, import inventory and persistence ownership should extend it or sit beside it while leaving existing approved checks unchanged.
Which persistence/table ownership rules are 'mechanically expressible' from existing sources. The rest must be routed to qualitative independent review rather than silently skipped.

How a held (unclassified or leakage) domain import is represented in the design-admission flow, and how it differs from a mechanical FAIL. The text says a detected dependency is evidence for classification, not an automatic defect.

How FX-U6 fixtures (forbidden dependency, incompatible interface, introduced cycle, unclassified domain import, conforming design) are constructed without changing real cross-module imports in src/alienintent.
How the separate attributable independent review is recorded alongside the mechanical PASS in the design-admission evidence, reusing the WO-220205 mechanics.
material_risks: Implicitly re-introducing the withdrawn R1 allowed_edges policy through a hard-coded allowlist when classifying domain imports. The verifier should check that classification cites bounded-context ownership and pinned contracts, not a reconstructed edge table.

New checks run against src/alienintent may flag existing cross-module imports. A broad refactor is explicitly not authorized, so these must be classified or held, not rewritten or treated as automatic defects.
Changing the behavior or strictness of existing approved architecture checks, which must remain normative and unchanged.

Reported, not independently verified: the escalation clause requires a pinned decision and a reviewed affected design/DAG revision before implementation. The text says the BIU was compiled from an independently reviewed planning revision and lists the same-day Founder disposition as a fixed decision. If that reviewed revision does not actually incorporate the 2026-09-25 disposition, this becomes a HOLD.
Persistence ownership checks may be only partly expressible mechanically. Coverage gaps could be misreported as PASS instead of explicit holds or qualitative-review items.
Verifier availability (Codex capacity) is an execution-time concern. Release must hold safely if the verifier is unavailable.
assessment.next_action: Hand off to PRODUCER as eligible (not release-authorized). First confirm that the pinned baseline 6ea9284 and candidate contract sha aa3598d6… correspond to a reviewed design revision incorporating the 2026-09-25 Founder coupling disposition, and hold if they do not. Then locate the bounded-context ownership sources and extend the architecture fitness and design-admission surfaces with cycle, domain-import-classification and persistence-ownership checks. Build FX-U6 with one negative control per material failure class, run the focused commands, and publish the exact candidate SHA for JC's independent verification.
assessment.rationale: READY is the controlling disposition because the one owner-level question that shaped this node, directional/coupling authority, is stated as disposed by the Founder with a concrete narrowed policy. The non-goals also exclude replanning, the withdrawn policy and broad refactors. The work is a single capability under one requirement and acceptance criterion, so there are no independent decision centers that would justify SPLIT. The remaining unknowns are engineering research: locating ownership contracts, extending existing checks and fixture design. Prerequisites are reported available (WO-220205 DONE, existing proof surfaces, allocated producer/verifier, custody and landing rules), so HOLD is not warranted on the text supplied, though the reviewed-design-revision condition is flagged as a risk to confirm. Acceptance is observable through discriminating negative controls and named commands, one independent verdict can assess the whole extent, and failures should be repairable locally within the check/fixture surfaces. This assessment recommends eligibility only; it does not authorize implementation or release.
assessment.summary: This is one cohesive capability, direction_disposed_applicability, with a single governing requirement. The owner decision that previously blocked it (directional authority) is reported as disposed by the Founder on 2026-09-25, and the text narrows it to evidence-driven checks. Scope, non-goals, proof fixture FX-U6, material failure classes, negative-control policy, existing proof surfaces, bounded commands, custody, verifier allocation and landing are all stated. The remaining uncertainty is engineering work: how to build the import classification and the persistence-ownership checks from existing artifacts. It is not unresolved owner intent. The predecessor WO-220205 is reported DONE, and its proof is consumed without reopening it.
assessment.verification_assessment: Acceptance is observable and one independent verdict is meaningful. Each of the four material failure classes has a discriminating negative control: forbidden dependency or incompatible interface fails before review; an introduced cycle is detected, and the negative control fails if the check is bypassed; a domain import is either classified or held; a conforming fixture records mechanical PASS plus a separate attributable review. Each control has intact/fault/restored evidence. The named focused pytest targets and the check_architecture.py --check all invocation give concrete, reproducible commands, with full regression as a terminal check. A fresh verifier working on the exact candidate SHA can judge the whole extent coherently. The main judgment call is whether the domain-import classification is grounded in real ownership contracts rather than an implicit re-creation of the withdrawn R1 edge table.
